elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Your iPhone can go silent for everyone except family.

[confident] Here's the fix. Set up a Focus.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Focus. Pick the people who can still reach you. Turn it on in Control Center.

[delighted] Everything else waits quietly, and family still gets straight through.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
